body:
## Pull request overview

This PR updates the Console shell to a Supabase-style layout where the top bar spans full width and the sidebar/content sit beneath it, and moves app switching into the top bar.

**Changes:**
- Refactors `AppShell` to render a full-width sticky header above the sidebar/content split.
- Introduces a new `AppSwitcher` component and integrates it into `AppHeader`; simplifies `UnifiedSidebar` accordingly.
- Updates `ConsoleLayout` to pass app-switching props into the header and adjusts layout padding overrides.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx | Refactors shell structure to “top bar + lower split” within `SidebarProvider`. |
| apps/console/src/components/UnifiedSidebar.tsx | Removes sidebar header switcher/search/footer actions; adds top-offset styling and a footer collapse trigger. |
| apps/console/src/components/ConsoleLayout.tsx | Plumbs `activeAppName/onAppChange` into `AppHeader`; forces `!p-0` to override responsive padding. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSwitcher.tsx | Adds a top-bar app switcher dropdown component. |
| apps/console/src/components/AppHeader.tsx | Renders AppSwitcher (desktop), retains mobile SidebarTrigger, and adds a user profile dropdown. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/AppHeader.test.tsx | Adds a mock for `AppSwitcher` (but mocks are now incomplete for new AppHeader deps). |
</details>

AppShell now renders a full-width sticky top bar, but any shadcn `Sidebar` (which is `position: fixed; inset-y-0` by default) will still start at `top: 0` and end up behind/under the top bar unless each sidebar implementation manually offsets itself. This already affects `InternalSidebar` in `AppSchemaRenderer` (it renders `<Sidebar collapsible="icon">` without a top offset), so schema-rendered apps will have the sidebar obscured. Consider providing an explicit top-bar height contract (e.g., CSS variable) and updating built-in sidebars to use `top-[var(--app-shell-topbar-height)]`, or otherwise ensuring sidebars are consistently offset when AppShell has a top bar.

`SidebarInset` renders a `
` element, and AppShell currently nests another `
` inside it. This produces invalid/awkward document structure (nested mains) and can confuse assistive tech. Consider making the inner container a `
`/`section`, or move the scroll/padding classes onto `SidebarInset` and render `children` directly inside it. ```suggestion
{children}
```

App switching appears to be desktop-only now (`AppSwitcher` is `hidden md:flex`), and UnifiedSidebar no longer contains an app switcher. That means on mobile there may be no way to switch apps. Consider rendering a compact/icon-only AppSwitcher on mobile (or reintroduce a switcher entry in the mobile sidebar/drawer) so app switching remains possible on small screens.

After adding AppSwitcher/user-profile UI to `AppHeader`, this test file's mocks are now incomplete: `AppHeader` imports `useNavigate` (react-router-dom), `useAuth`/`getUserInitials` (@object-ui/auth), additional dropdown components (`DropdownMenuLabel/Separator/Group`) and avatar components from `@object-ui/components`, plus extra lucide icons (Settings/LogOut/ChevronsUpDown/User). Without mocking these, the tests will fail with invalid element type / missing hook errors. Please extend the mocks accordingly (or switch to a partial mock that re-exports the real module and overrides only the pieces needed).

This refactor removed several previously described/expected sidebar affordances (e.g., back-to-home entry, navigation search filtering via `searchQuery`, and the settings/help/user profile footer). Help/user actions may be intentionally moved to the top bar, but navigation search + an explicit home/exit affordance look like functional regressions relative to the issue plan. If the removal is unintended, consider re-adding nav search (wire a `SidebarInput` back into `NavigationRenderer`) and providing a clear route back to `/home` from app context.
